records.source_scope: Study-qualified nominal bleached Curauá-fiber/rigid-polyurethane-foam formulation. Fiber loading is author-reported wt.% relative to total RPUF mass, not an analyzed final retained composition, pure polymer identity, certified grade, or exact lot chemistry. Distinct reinforcement loadings identify three formulations; curing, cutting, directions and test specimens do not add identities. Only three Table 2 apparent-density means for bleached Curauá-fiber RPUF composites are selected. Neat RPUF, mechanical properties, calculated morphology and other properties are excluded. Density temperature, pressure, humidity, measurement age, independent production-batch count and porosity are unknown. Ten density samples per group are reported; five mechanical samples and conditions from other tests are not assigned to density. Superscript coefficient-of-variance annotations have no explicit unit and are preserved literally, never interpreted as percent, SD, or zero uncertainty. Section 3.2 reports room-condition curing for 24 h before cutting; Section 2 thermal-conductivity discussion describes the studied foams as post-cured for at least 7 days. The density measurement age and relation of these stages are unresolved. Neither 24 h nor 7 days is assigned as density measurement age.

records.source_scope: Study-qualified DCP-reactive PBS / 45 wt.% Indulin AT softwood kraft lignin formulation R45 (Ewurum and McDonald 2025); lignin percentage is relative to total polymer mass. The nominal DCP-containing formulation and source-reported reaction distinguish this R-series from the corresponding B-series simple blend. Table 1 reports a nonzero gel fraction of 26.2% for R45; this supports the source reaction distinction, not a certified final network or an extra selected property. Different lignin loadings distinguish the four candidates. Processing routes, specimens, translated labels and measured differences alone do not create additional identities. Composite denotes a lignin-filled polymer formulation, not a pure molecular species or a continuous-fiber laminate. The source says 0.25 wt.% DCP added to PBS. Its exact denominator and final retained DCP are not resolved; no final mass fractions, crosslink density, graft fraction, molecular architecture or chemical purity are inferred. Section 2.1 gives BioPBS FZ91PM/FZ91PB without resolving a single grade. Keep grade_id null; the R labels are study formulations, not commercial grades. Section 2.4 (PDF p.4) determines contextual gel fractions on hot-pressed DCP cross-linked PBS-lignin material, not the injection-molded tensile dog-bones. These results support formulation-level reaction context only and do not determine the tensile specimens’ gel fraction or final network. Independent catalog TGA context only,not independent experiment or production batch. Thermal-piece physical lineage/conditioning unknown.
